TweaksPageDescription: These controls show the same optimizations SynergyOS applies for performance, latency, privacy, and quality of life. Adjust them to suit your setup â€” each setting can be changed back.
TweaksWarningMessage: Be careful with these changes. Not every tweak will perform the same on every PC. Create a System Restore point before applying optimizations so you can roll back if something breaks. Some tweaks require a restart.
TweaksPerformanceSubMenuDescription: CPU scheduling, memory, filesystem, and timer optimizations used by SynergyOS.
TweaksNetworkPowerSubMenuDescription: Network latency tweaks and device power-saving controls.
TweaksPrivacySubMenuDescription: Telemetry reduction, settings sync, and Windows Update driver delivery.
TweaksInterfaceSubMenuDescription: Explorer, taskbar, mouse, and desktop quality-of-life tweaks.
AmdGpuTweaksSubMenuDescription: Imribiy AMD Radeon DWORD packs for driver-only installs. Requires an AMD GPU â€” otherwise toggles stay unavailable.
AmdGpuRequired: Requires an AMD GPU with AMD display drivers installed.
AmdDriverTelemetryDescription: Disable AMD driver analytics, subscription prompts, and release-note popups. Restart required.
AmdFeatureLatencyDescription: Tune Chill, Anti-Lag, Radeon Boost, stutter, and framebuffer compression related DWORD values. Restart required.
AmdPowerPlayDescription: Force higher PowerPlay performance levels and reduce deep-sleep / race-to-idle behavior. Restart required. May raise power and heat.
AmdUlpsDescription: Disable Ultra Low Power State on the AMD adapter. Restart required. May raise idle power.
AmdAspmDescription: Disable PCIe Active State Power Management (L0s/L1) on the AMD adapter. Restart required.
AmdClockGatingDescription: Disable multiple AMD clock-gating paths for steadier clocks. Restart required. Increases power use.
AmdPowerGatingDescription: Disable AMD power-gating blocks (GFX/UVD/VCE/SMU hubs, etc.). Restart required. Increases power use.
AmdDisplayPowerDescription: Force max display clock and disable DAL deep sleep / clock gating. Restart required.
AmdSpreadSpectrumDescription: Disable GPU spread-spectrum clocking. Restart required.
AmdCrashDefenderDescription: Disable AMD Crash Defender and related logging services (amdfendr/amdlog). Restart required.
GpuPage_AmdTweaksDescription: AMD Radeon driver DWORD optimizations based on imribiy's amd-gpu-tweaks. Apply only on AMD systems; a restart is required for most changes.
